Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: AP onboarding & PO fields

Hi Naomi — thanks, happy to get this over. I attached our AP Onboarding Packet and a sample EU invoice file (XML) with the VAT split and PO header fields populated. High level answers below and notes for your AP team:

1) e-Invoice delivery: we support SFTP push, SFTP pull, and a secured HTTP POST endpoint. Preferred for high-volume is SFTP drop with a per-vendor subdirectory; we can provide creds or consume a vendor token from your portal.

2) Required invoice fields for PO matching:
- invoiceHeader/poNumber (mandatory) — our parser reads the PO at header level by default; we can also enable line-level matching if you send line PO refs in invoiceLine/poReference.
- invoiceHeader/invoiceDate, invoiceHeader/currency, invoiceHeader/totalAmount
- invoiceLines: description, qty, unitPrice, taxAmount, taxRate

3) VAT: please provide the purchaser VAT ID for EU entities in the PO metadata (poHeader/purchaserVatId). Our sample (attached) shows a three-line VAT breakdown (taxable base, tax amount, tax code).

4) Remit & banking: we accept IBAN + SWIFT for EU wire instructions. In the packet we include an EFT remittance example (preferred) and an alternate physical address for non-EU customers.

Next steps I recommend:
- Please send the vendor token or portal invite URL and the legal entity name as it should appear on invoices.
- If Olive requires line-level PO matching enabled, confirm and we will toggle that on our side.
- I included a sample invoice filename: invoice_sample_eu.xml for your parser team to test.

Attachments: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet.pdf (AP packet with field mapping and remit matrix), invoice_sample_eu.xml

Thanks — I can hop on a 20-min call with your AP engineer if you want to walk through the sample mapping live.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni

Vivek — quick redline suggestions for the packet before we send the final to Olive's AP:

- Add explicit default payment term (Net 30) and where Olive can set early-pay opt-in.
- Make PO matching configurable in packet: header-only (default) vs. line-level (opt-in). Call out the expected PO field path for both options.
- Add an explicit field for VAT breakdown per-line and an example where tax rate differs by line.
- Clarify that vendor legal entity name must match the new vendor token payload exactly to avoid duplicate vendor records.
- Add a small troubleshooting checklist for failed PO matches (missing PO, currency mismatch, mismatched purchaser VAT ID).

I attached a light redline (redlined_packet.pdf) with inline comments. If you want, I'll send a cleaned version to Naomi once you confirm the final wording for remit instructions (IBAN vs. domestic ACH).
